shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50; cat README* 2>/dev/null | head -30

cat src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls Table Table/hoc Table/hoc/*; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; cat Pagination/types.d.ts Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; cat Table/Table.d.ts | head -150; ls ../../../ | head

grep -n "static getRowId" -A 12 Table/Table.js; cat Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.css; grep -n "export" Table/index.d.ts Table/hoc/index.d.ts; cat ../../../package.json | grep -n '"exports"' -A5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30 && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -20

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/DataTable.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""const EnhancedTable = withTableSelection<TableDataItem>(withTableSorting<TableDataItem>(Table));""","""const EnhancedTable = withTableSelection<TableDataItem, WithTableSortingProps>(
    withTableSorting<TableDataItem>(Table),
);""")
s=s.replace("""    TableSortState,
} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';""","""    TableSortState,
    WithTableSortingProps,
} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; rm -rf dist; git status --short
